_comment: Canonical numeric claims for the site. Single source of truth: index.html renders
the receipts table from this file, so a number is corrected in exactly one place.
`superseded` lists values this claim used to assert. scripts/check_claims.py fails
the build if any of them reappears anywhere in the site, so a corrected number
cannot quietly come back — which is exactly what happened to three of these: they
survived a full restructure of index.html because the prose and the curated meta
